context: Hybrid full-stack marketplace and admin dashboard

theme.reason: Students need confidence and scanability during discovery and checkout; a warm light canvas makes downloadable academic products feel approachable while an ink-dark admin mode supports focus.

discovery.content_strategy: Lead with outcomes and proof: what the student can run, learn, submit, and present. Use concise metadata before long descriptions.

design_directions.name: Archive / Signal
design_directions.description: Swiss editorial marketplace fused with technical documentation and library archive cues. Warm paper canvas, signal orange actions, dark ink typography, visible system metadata.

design_directions.name: Studio Bench
design_directions.description: Workshop catalog fused with university lab notebook and premium software store. Tactile borders, annotated previews, earthy blue and clay accents.

design_directions.name: Launchpad
design_directions.description: Mission-control dashboard fused with academic planner and product hunt. Dense but calm metrics, red-orange status markers, asymmetric featured project blocks.

design_directions.name: Night Lab
design_directions.description: Dark technical console fused with cinematic editorial typography and code editor surfaces. Reserve for admin and power-user analytics, not checkout.

design_directions.name: Field Notes
design_directions.description: Documentary learning journal fused with modular ecommerce catalog. Generous whitespace, image-led stories, handwritten-style accent used sparingly.

typography.rationale: A humanist technical voice feels trustworthy without defaulting to Inter. Use 800 weight for impact and 400/450 body weight for calm reading.

colors.archetype: Swiss & high-contrast with warm paper twist
colors.forbidden: #7351B7 and teal dashboard palettes; never use pure #000000 or #808080
colors.usage: Use signal only for CTA, active filters, price emphasis, and status. Keep 85-90% surfaces neutral. No full-screen gradients.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle CSS grain using a low-opacity data URI or pseudo-element; never reduce text contrast.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat paper surfaces with 1px tinted borders; use glass only for sticky nav with bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/60.
visual_enhancers.decorative_language: Thin measurement ticks, category index numbers, dotted rules, cropped product screenshots, and small mono annotations.
visual_enhancers.custom_scrollbar: Use a 6px thumb in #B7B4AA on #F6F3EC; no gutter.
visual_enhancers.avoid: generic hero gradients, centered-everything, excessive rounded cards, emoji icons, placeholder image URLs.

grids.marketplace: Tetris grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8; featured project spans 8 columns and 2 rows, supporting modules span 4 columns, leave intentional breathing cells.
grids.catalog: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6; cards are flat direct grid children with image, title, stack, deliverables, price and CTA.
grids.admin: High-density grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4; KPI col-span-1, primary analytics col-span-2 row-span-2, activity feed col-span-1 row-span-2.
grids.rule: Grid items must be direct children; animation wrappers must carry the grid classes. Use align-items:start and h-full only where matching row height is intentional.

layouts.global_nav: Visible desktop nav with brand, Projects, Categories, How it works, Resources, cart and primary CTA. Solid paper or opaque glass background, z-50 when sticky.
layouts.landing: Asymmetric editorial hero: left-aligned headline and search, right-side stacked project preview and outcome index. Follow with category rail, featured projects, three-step process, trust strip, FAQ and dark contrast footer.
layouts.catalog: Search/filter rail on desktop and Shadcn Sheet on mobile; sort via Shadcn DropdownMenu, never native select. Preserve filter chips and result count.
layouts.detail: Product title, discipline, price and purchase CTA first; tabs for Overview, What is included, Setup, Learning path, Reviews. Show preview gallery, compatibility, support and related projects.
layouts.checkout: Two-column desktop contract: order summary and secure payment panel. Explicit deliverables, license terms, refund policy and payment state. Never show success until backend verifies payment.
layouts.student_dashboard: Sidebar with Purchases, Downloads, Learning, Profile; progress and recent downloads in dense but spacious modules.
layouts.admin: Protected sidebar routes Overview, Projects, Categories, Orders, Users, Analytics, SEO, Settings. Use tables, filters, empty states and activity timeline; no excessive cards.

components.preferred: Use existing Button, Input, Badge, Tabs, Sheet, DropdownMenu, Dialog, Table, Skeleton, Progress, Tooltip and Sonner components. Customize classes to match the system.
components.interaction_rules: Every interactive element has hover, active, focus-visible and pressed states with explicit text color. Use Sonner for cart, auth, payment and download feedback.

motion.entrance: Stagger catalog cards 50ms with opacity and translateY(8px).
motion.hover: Project cards lift -translate-y-1 with border-color and shadow transition; buttons use transform scale(0.98) on press.
motion.loading: Use skeleton blocks for images, metadata and tables; never flash empty layout.
motion.scroll: Optional Lenis only on marketing/landing route; do not add smooth scrolling to checkout or admin.
motion.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables parallax, stagger and transform animation; keep opacity/state feedback. Use specific transitions, never transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Normal text >=4.5:1, large text >=3:1; test signal buttons with white text and signal_dark for hover.
accessibility.keyboard: Visible high-contrast focus ring, logical tab order, Escape closes dialogs/sheets, focus trap through Radix primitives.
accessibility.semantics: Use landmarks, labelled inputs, table captions, aria-live for payment/download status, alt text for all project imagery.
accessibility.testing: All buttons, links, inputs, menus, balances, errors, purchase/download confirmations and key project metadata require data-testid in kebab-case.

media.strategy: Use project screenshots, diagrams and short video thumbnails as educational proof. Images must remain below 80vh on mobile. Demo references are replaceable and should move to signed/private asset API before production.

image_urls.description: Student working on laptop; use as editorial hero or learning story image.
Student coding at laptop; use for full-stack or AI project preview.
Student learning with headphones; use for video lesson module.
Laptop detail; use as replaceable demo product visual.

media.protection: Do not expose private source-code URLs in frontend. Request download entitlement from FastAPI and consume short-lived signed URLs.

3d_libraries.decision: No 3D required for MVP; clarity beats immersion for academic product purchase.
3d_libraries.optional: If a later marketing hero needs depth, lazy-load React Three Fiber with Suspense and transparent background; do not block catalog or checkout.

backend_contracts.auth: Supabase email/password integration point with Google OAuth prepared; client only receives session, never service role key.
backend_contracts.payments: FastAPI creates Razorpay order server-side, verifies signature server-side, persists payment state, then unlocks entitlement. No fake success flow.
backend_contracts.downloads: GET /api/purchases/{id}/downloads returns authorized short-lived signed URLs after entitlement check.
backend_contracts.admin: Require server-side role/admin email allowlist or Supabase claim; admin routes must fail closed.
backend_contracts.seo: Per-route metadata contract for title, description, canonical and project structured data.

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.spacing: Use generous p-6/p-8/p-12 sections and 2-3x typical whitespace; bordered containers always have internal padding.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.responsive: Mobile-first. Desktop nav links visible; hamburger only mobile. Avoid images over 80vh on mobile.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.headers: Never use fully transparent backgrounds behind content. Use opaque paper or glass with blur and border.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.buttons: Use sharp or modestly pill-shaped buttons with clear primary hierarchy; primary color limited to key actions.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.states: Build loading, error, empty, disabled, hover, focus, active and success states for every major flow.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.code: Files are JavaScript/JSX, not TypeScript/TSX. Keep API adapters replaceable and avoid hardcoded secrets.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.anti_slop: Do not center the app container, use generic gradients, Inter headings, uniform equal-card grids, or emoji as icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Archive / Signal as the default direction. Preserve the existing FastAPI integration shape and add Supabase/Razorpay service adapters rather than mocking production flows. Seed six realistic projects across AI/ML, Generative AI, Computer Vision, Full Stack, Data Science and NLP. Add data-testid to all interactive and key informational elements.
